privacyModal.title: 100% Guaranteed Privacy
privacyModal.subtitle: Processed 100% locally in your web browser
privacyModal.cpuTitle: Your processor does all the work

privacyModal.offlineDesc: You can turn off your Wi-Fi: the application will continue working smoothly because no file is ever sent to any remote server.
privacyModal.privacyDesc: Perfect for sensitive documents like payslips, IDs, bank statements, tax forms, or confidential contracts.

hero.badge: No data transfer: 100% executed on your device
hero.description: Merge, organize, split, sign, and convert your documents without risking sharing your private data with third-party servers.

guarantees.privacyDesc: Your payslips, identity cards, and contracts stay on your device. Not a single byte is uploaded to the cloud.
guarantees.speedDesc: No upload or download wait times. Processing taps directly into the computing power of your CPU.
guarantees.freeDesc: No arbitrary restrictions on page count or file size. No login, tracking, or subscription required.

footer.rights: © 2026 PrivatePDF — 100% Client-Side. Your documents remain strictly on your computer.
